title: Reconciliation SLA policy
description: Deadlines of the period reconciliation (SME R3 / R6, EXPERT_REVIEW phase R-C): submission and approval due a number of hours after the production day ends, the resubmission time after a rejection, the escalation steps by age (hours since the production day ended, time waiting for data not counted) and the rejection count that escalates. Tenant-wide; seeded per plant on first use. Consumed by `src/domain/close/reconciliation-sla.ts` (and its SQL mirror `src/close/sla-sql.ts`).

submitWithinHours.description: Submission due this many hours after the production day ends (SME R3 pilot: 12).

approveWithinHours.description: Approval due this many hours after the production day ends (SME R3 pilot: 24); not before the submission.

resubmitWithinHours.description: After a rejection the corrected submission is due this many hours after it (never before the first due time).

escalations.description: Escalation levels 1, 2, ... in rising afterHours (SME R3 pilot: 48 h production accounting, 72 h plant management).

rejectionEscalationCount.description: The n-th rejection of the same revision escalates (SME R6: the third).
